title: The big moon is a trick
caption: The moon on the horizon isn't bigger. Your brain is just comparing.

beats.head: The huge moon on the horizon is *not* bigger.
It's the same size as when it's *high* overhead.
beats.sub: If anything, it's a hair farther away.

beats.head: Try it: cover it with your *pinky* at arm's length.
beats.sub: Low or high, it fits the same.

beats.head: It's called the *moon illusion*.
beats.sub: Scientists still argue over exactly why it happens.

beats.head: One idea: your brain compares it to *trees* and rooftops.
beats.sub: Next to something familiar, it suddenly feels enormous.

beats.head: The moon didn't change. *How you looked* did.
beats.sub: Worth a second look at someone you scrolled past.

beats.head: Send this to the one who's *huge* on your horizon.
